collection.description: A blind cartographer who knows the shoreline by sound and touch is doubted by a visiting apprentice.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A blind adult knows the shoreline by wind, sound, slope, and the feel of stone. A visiting apprentice doubts their ability to help map a new path.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Their detailed sensory route reveals a safer path; the apprentice gains respect and a new way of observing.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They devise tactile markers and verbal descriptions, though their first map needs correction after a storm.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They choose to teach navigation instead of joining the expedition. Nobody treats the decision as failure.
